subject: mechanical-engineering
intro: Mechanical engineering leads wherever machines are conceived, built and kept running — engines and power plant, factories and vehicles, and the HVAC systems that keep buildings habitable.

roles.title: Mechanical Engineers
roles.what: Perform engineering duties in planning and designing tools, engines, machines and other mechanically functioning equipment, and oversee the installation, operation, maintenance and repair of systems such as centralised heat, gas, water and steam plant.
roles.where: Every unit maps onto the job: statics and dynamics for loads, stress analysis and fatigue for machine elements, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics for power cycles, then heat transfer and measurement for real equipment.

roles.title: Materials Engineers
roles.what: Evaluate materials and develop the machinery and processes that manufacture them — metals, ceramics, polymers and composites — so products meet specialised design and performance specifications; includes metallurgists and welding engineers.
roles.where: The manufacturing and materials unit — materials selection, casting, forming and machining, additive manufacturing — and the mechanics-of-materials strand on stress, fatigue and failure theories are this role's daily toolkit.

roles.title: Industrial Engineers
roles.what: Design, develop, test and evaluate integrated systems for managing industrial production processes — human work factors, quality control, inventory control, logistics and material flow, cost analysis and production coordination.
roles.where: Instrumentation, measurement and control feeds the quality side; materials selection and the manufacturing processes unit inform the production systems you streamline, with dynamics covering the human and machine work factors.

roles.title: Heating, Air Conditioning, and Refrigeration Mechanics and Installers
roles.what: Install or repair heating, central air conditioning, HVAC and refrigeration systems, including oil burners, hot-air furnaces and heating stoves — the equipment that keeps buildings comfortable and food cold.
roles.where: The HVAC and refrigeration unit is the direct match: psychrometrics, heating and cooling loads and refrigeration cycles are exactly what you service, with thermodynamics and heat transfer explaining why the equipment behaves as it does.
